conflict-resolver.reason: A design decision disguised as a merge: 'preserve both' compiles but ships two overlapping mechanisms, and nothing downstream catches a wrong call.

delegation-roi-analysis.reason: Beyond counting and grouping it proposes changes to delegation policy — a wrong recommendation has no test to catch it.

headless-executor-contract.reason: Defines how the Executor itself behaves — the role it governs is the high-volume, spec-driven implementation side, not the Architect side reading it.

orchestration-methodology.reason: Dispatch, polling, bookkeeping, close-out — mistakes here surface immediately as a stuck task or a failed verification step.

task-delegation.reason: Spec authoring and substantial verification of an Executor's output — a bad spec gets implemented faithfully, and a bad review approves it.

interactive-role-setup.reason: A wrong role-to-model mapping degrades every other skill silently, downstream, for as long as it goes unnoticed.
